remarks: First time on the market in 27 years this conveniently located building, updated in 2018, has provided good income to its owner with its three recently renovated units. The first-floor and second-floor apartments both have in-unit laundry and an office/den for added living space. The third-floor unit, while smaller, is a "nest in the sky," with the recent addition of a locked, private laundry room in the basement. Close to public transportation, schools, route 95, and Greenwich Metro North station. Requesting highest & best offers by Saturday 10/25 at 5pm.
